gate_contracts.outcome: design document describes architecture, components, and interfaces
design report records decisions and trade-offs
simplicity gate: design document is bounded in scope and does not introduce excessive external dependencies
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Semantic judgment required: does the design introduce unjustified abstraction layers, unnecessary configuration files, or dependencies that could be replaced with simpler alternatives? The structural check verifies the design report records complexity analysis; only human review can assess whether the design is actually simple.

gate_contracts.outcome: quality audit verdict is recorded for phase artifacts
technical decisions include rationale and current source URLs
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm each material technical decision is supported by relevant primary sources and contradictory evidence is resolved.

gate_contracts.outcome: architecture decisions use multiple unique online sources with rationale
mid-phase checkpoint evidence demonstrates findings were corrected before final design
UI design language is documented with color palette, typography scale, spacing system, and component patterns — anchored to a brand reference or original design system
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs pattern docs/DESIGN.canvas.tsx "(palette|color|typography|type scale|spacing|component|design language|design system|brand)"
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Semantic judgment required: does the design language demonstrate intentional aesthetic decisions rather than generic AI defaults? The structural check verifies the design document records specific visual design decisions (colors, typography, spacing, components); only human review can assess whether the design is distinctive and purposeful. N/A for projects with no UI.

gate_contracts.outcome: design references at least one brand design system or documents an original design system with rationale
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs pattern prime/reports/phase-3-design.md "(brand|design system|design reference|inspired by|design anchor|stripe|linear|vercel|apple|notion|airbnb|shopify|figma|raycast|supabase|resend|posthog|warp|sentry)"
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the referenced brand or design system was actually consulted (not just name-dropped) and that the design decisions trace back to it. N/A for projects with no UI.

gate_contracts.outcome: design document uses specific design token vocabulary and anti-slop patterns from loaded references (not generic descriptions)
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs pattern docs/DESIGN.canvas.tsx "(design token|--[a-z]+-[a-z]+|oklch|hsl|clamp|type scale|modular scale|4px|8px|spacing scale|radius|shadow|elevation|z-index|motion|transition|easing|duration|breakpoint|grid|container query)"
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Verify the design document records specific design token values (not just 'choose a color palette'). The design should show evidence of consulting DESIGN-QUALITY.md references: specific spacing scales, typography scales, color systems (oklch/hsl), responsive breakpoints, and motion patterns. Generic descriptions like 'use a modern color palette' indicate the reference was not loaded. N/A for projects with no UI.
